features.name: OSC 8 hyperlink `;` URI encoding
features.notes: AGY 1.4.1 (changelog_reference.txt:13): 'Fixed clickable links in agent responses whose URL contains `;` opening a URL cut off at the first `;` in terminals and multiplexers that split link sequences on semicolons.' Cycle 240 ships the minimum-viable percent-encoder (`urlForOSC8` + `osc8URIReplacer` in internal/render/url_osc8_encode.go) that percent-encodes the OSC-8-significant characters `;` -> `%3B` and `\` -> `%5C` in the URI segment of the OSC 8 frame at internal/render/render.go:Hyperlink, plus 7 tests in url_osc8_encode_test.go covering the literal regression case, the backslash-pinned case, the no-special-char byte-identity contract, the empty-input contract, the multi-semicolon encoding, the purity contract, and the integration test that the OSC 8 emitter encodes the URI but leaves the *label* (body) text verbatim. The label-text distinction is what lets callers pass user-facing text like 'Choose: yes; no' as the body without it becoming 'Choose: yes%3B no'. Full RFC 3986 percent-encoding is out of scope (other OSC-significant chars and percent-triplet handling are caller's responsibility, per the bug-report's surface).

features.name: Auto-continue has separate network retry budget (8)
features.notes: AGY 1.4.x (changelog_reference.txt:10): 'Fixed socket disconnect errors such as broken pipe, software caused connection abort, network is down, and http2: client connection lost (for example after laptop sleep or a Wi-Fi change) stopping the turn with `Agent execution terminated due to error.` instead of retrying automatically and reporting a network error if retries fail.' The clone splits the auto-continue budget by error class — transient network/socket errors get AutoContMaxNetworkDepth (=8) retries, every other class keeps AutoContMaxDepth (=3). IsTransientNetworkErr walks the wrapped-error chain over a verbatim-phrase list (broken pipe, software caused connection abort, network is down, network is unreachable, http2: client connection lost, http2: stream closed, http2: client disconnected, connection reset by peer, connection refused, connection timed out, i/o timeout, no such host, handshake timeout, tls: oversized record received, unexpected eof, eof, use of closed network connection, server closed idle connection, server closed connection) and skips context.Canceled / context.DeadlineExceeded. After the network budget exhausts, the loop wraps the last error in *ErrAutoContNetworkFailed (preserves typed *backend.HTTPError via Unwrap / errors.As) so the TUI can render a clear 'Network error: <last>' banner. Quota / scope / 4xx / non-network permanent errors still fail fast at AutoContMaxDepth, matching the pre-cycle behaviour. 27 tests in 2 files: 18 phrase cases + 1 wrapped-chain + 1 context-precedence + 2 typed-error contract (Error() / Unwrap) + 1 nested Unwrap walk in transient_network_test.go, plus 3 budget-defaults + 1 preset-matrix reconciliation + the existing TestLoop_AutoContGiveUpAfterMaxDepth (which still pins AutoContMaxDepth=3 and 2 banner firings) in auto_continue_test.go.

features.notes: AGY 1.4.x (changelog_reference.txt:271): 'Improved authentication error messages when OAuth tokens lack required scopes by including explicit instructions to run /logout and /login.' Detection is precise — HTTP 403 plus a body keyword scan over `insufficient_scope`, `missing scope`, `requires scope`, `scope required` (all case-insensitive); a 403 without the keyword does NOT trigger the hint. The canonical constant is backend.OAuthScopeHintMessage ('Run `/logout` then `/login` to refresh your OAuth grant with the required scopes.'). Print mode surfaces the hint in two places: the user-facing `error:` line (upstream body + hint appended) and a new `remediation` field on the AGY_ERROR JSON envelope (omitempty, so the canonical envelope shape for every other failure mode stays unchanged). The TUI handler in cmd/wagyu/tui_run.go now forwards chunk.Error text to m.response via backendChunkMsg with the same conditional hint append — the print path and the interactive path move together. 7 tests in 2 files: 6 predicate/wire tests in internal/backend/scope_hint_test.go (403+insufficient_scope, 403+missing-scope, 403 generic, 401 not enough, case-insensitive, preserves-original-error) plus the print-mode envelope test in cmd/wagyu/api_error_test.go (TestScopeHint_PrintModeRemediation + TestScopeHint_NonScopeErrorHasNoRemediation).

features.name: Background command final output always recorded
features.notes: AGY 1.4.0 changelog line 24: 'Fixed a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log; the output is now always recorded when the command finishes or is canceled.' Cycle 258 ships recordFinalOutput(buf, log, reason) as the single exit point every bg termination reason converges on (normal finish, non-zero exit, signal kill via kill(), user cancel). The function copies the tail of the live safeBuffer into a new bgTask.log safeBuffer and appends a one-line exit reason produced by bgExitReason (mapping: nil → 'exit code 0', *exec.ExitError → 'exit code N', context.Canceled → 'canceled', context.DeadlineExceeded → 'timed out'). Idempotency comes from a sync.Once on safeBuffer.appendOnce, so the cmd.Wait goroutine's defer and kill()'s call race-safely. The defer pattern in start() wraps the body in a recover() that synthesises a 'panic: <v>' reason so a panic during shutdown still records the log. Memory is bounded by bgLogTailBytes (4096) — commands that print megabytes get a '[truncated N bytes]' marker plus the last 4 KiB, mirroring the cycle-198 truncate policy used for tool outputs. bgTask.status() reads from t.log (the persistent log) when t.done is true, falling back to the live t.out buffer while the task is still running. 8 tests in internal/tools/bg_output_test.go cover NormalExit, ErrorExit, KilledBySignal, CanceledByUser, EmptyOutput, LargeOutput, Idempotent (race-with-once), and NilSafe (defer must not panic).
